id: title:Gilbert09:reuse the s3 filesystem in cdp and person property sinks

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces AWS SDK and S3FileSystem instantiation overhead in the CDP Producer and Person Property Row Sink, addressing potential file descriptor exhaustion risks during warehouse ingestion.
review.reason: The observed hunks implement a filesystem caching mechanism (`_fs_cache`) in `CDPProducer` and `PersonPropertyRowSink`. P1.F1.H3 explicitly assigns the created `S3FileSystem` to this cache and returns it on subsequent calls, while P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 establish the attribute. This prevents repeated instantiation of the underlying AWS SDK client and filesystem, which aligns with P1
review.uncertainty: The implementation relies on the supplied observations; no complete execution or test results are provided to independently verify the mitigation of file descriptor exhaustion or performance gains. The benefit is inferred from the caching pattern rather than demonstrated runtime behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the score assignment. The observations below are derived solely from the supplied hunks.

observations.behavior: Adds a private cache attribute `_fs_cache` to the `CDPProducer` class, initialized to None.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores a filesystem reference for reuse, supporting the caching behavior described in P1.F1.H2.

observations.behavior: Adds a private cache attribute `_fs_cache` to the `PersonPropertyRowSink` class, initialized to None.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores a filesystem reference for reuse, supporting the caching behavior described in P1.F2.H2.

observations.behavior: Changes the `_get_fs` method in `CDPProducer` to assign the created `S3FileSystem` instance to `self._fs_cache` instead of returning it immediately, and returns the cached instance on subsequent calls. Also adds an `else` branch to cache the filesystem for the non-local setup path.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the caching of the S3FileSystem object to prevent creating a new one and its underlying AWS SDK client on every call, addressing the file descriptor exhaustion risk described in P1.F1.H2.
